purpose: Track reusable modular 2D character art, tools and implementation references before integration.

sources.name: Custom VN Character: FBFFFM001 Fullbody Girl 1200px
sources.author: LinXueLian
sources.layering: separate numbered folders; body/face/eyes/hair/clothing/accessory variants per source description
sources.redistributionReviewed: source declares CC BY-SA 4.0; retain author attribution and license; inspect contents and verify all files before bundling
sources.notes: Closest visual fit to anime full-body layer customization. Layered facial, skin, hair, clothing and accessories do not prove independent movable arm/leg joints.

sources.name: Custom VN Character: HFFF001 Oujousama 700px
sources.author: LinXueLian

sources.notes: Layered anime art with shared base across packs; only mix assets where the creator's base and alignment match.

sources.name: Custom VN Character: HMLF001 Anime Boy 800px
sources.author: LinXueLian
sources.layering: base, expression, mouth, eyes, eyebrows, hair, ears, inner/outer garments, accessories
sources.notes: Confirm bust/full-body extent and keep compatibility within the same base.

sources.name: Universal LPC Spritesheet Generator
sources.author: Liberated Pixel Cup contributors
sources.layering: body, head, hair, headwear, arms, torso, legs, feet, tools and weapons; animated sprite sheets
sources.notes: The demo identifies individual authors and licenses. Do not treat every sheet as one permissive license; retain/export exact credits for chosen parts.

sources.name: LPC Unity Character Creator
sources.author: TCLowe1982 and upstream LPC contributors
sources.notes: Study layer sets, z-order, animation, palette recolor and selective import; its Unity code is not directly a web component and does not relicense its art.

sources.name: Kenney Roguelike Characters

sources.notes: Official page lists 450 files and CC0. Download and inspect piece structure and view directions before deciding whether it supports articulation.
